dogecoin.text: An shallow forensic analysis of what happened with $DOGE showed that when large holders sold their coins, many leveraged positions were liquidated. That accounts for the disproportionate volume of sellers. Millions of dollars lost on leverage.
When $DOGE fell last night, within a few minutes, the volume and prices of $BTC and $ETH surged. You know where the sellers put their money after they dumped.
To be fair, this Tweet May have prevented $Doge from going down 4 hours ago.
I'm glad I bought $DOGE over the last weekend. Thanks for the support @elonmusk!

I admit to buying a lot of $SHIB, and I am hoping creates better network effects. But if what happens is that people will simply HODL it instead of spend it, I’ll exit my position and buy $DOGE instead.

This should be interesting. Good thing I took my profit today from shorting #Bitcoin. It might go up tomorrow in anticipation of an an Elon endorsement. I wonder if I should get some $DOGE for speculation.
